git fetch {upstream_remote} || true
git merge --no-edit {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} || true
if test -f "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)"; then
  for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U); do
    git checkout --conflict=diff3 -- "$f"
    awk '
      /^<<<<<<</ { inblk = 1; sec = "ours"; no = 0; nb = 0; nt = 0; next }
      inblk && /^\|\|\|\|\|\|\|/ { sec = "base"; next }
      inblk && /^=======$/ { sec = "theirs"; next }
      inblk && /^>>>>>>>/ {
        for (i = 1; i <= nt; i++) print T[i]
        for (i = nb + 1; i <= no; i++) print O[i]
        inblk = 0; sec = ""; next
      }
      inblk {
        if (sec == "ours") O[++no] = $0
        else if (sec == "base") B[++nb] = $0
        else if (sec == "theirs") T[++nt] = $0
        next
      }
      { print }
    ' "$f" > "$f.merge-resolved"
    mv "$f.merge-resolved" "$f"
    git add -- "$f"
  done
  git commit --no-edit
fi
